basic_info.description: Location, Location, Location! Just one block from the vibrant Mission Street District  filled with renowned restaurants, cafs, nightlife,   and parks  this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home offers the best of San Francisco living. Enjoy Precita Park 1 block away, with Bernal Heights Park rising just above, where green space feels like an extension of your own backyard. Set in a quaint   and easy-going two-unit Edwardian building, this top floor unit features city views from your living room window, an updated kitchen, one-car parking, and charming personal backyard space overlooking the city skyline, perfect for morning coffee, a small garden, or a quiet retreat. With low HOA dues and a relaxed community vibe, it's an ideal   blend of character and convenience. Whether you're looking for neighborhood charm, close by amenities, or access to some of the   city's favorite outdoor spaces, this home delivers it all.
